problems.reason: Both sentences state that Gryposuchus is an extinct genus of gavialid crocodilian.
Sentence 20 limits Gryposuchus to the Miocene (Colhuehuapian–Huayquerian), while sentence 21 extends its range from the Burdigalian to the Late Pleistocene (≈20.45–0.0117 Ma).
